Package names, environment variables, service labels, route IDs, imports, filesystem paths, compatibility identifiers, and historical URLs were explicitly protected.
No forced visual changes without a concrete interaction or accessibility defect.
Creating a duplicate Settings.tsx without integrating its caller would not fix the live surface.
